summary: Multiasset netting/risk/MTM/DD WIRED and TESTED end-to-end on synthetic multi-symbol universes (no scaffold called ready). engine.py: run() extracted verbatim into a steppable _Replay (single-symbol behavior byte-identical; 211 pre-existing tests green before any new code landed) + new PortfolioEngine: session-lockstep multi-symbol replay over sorted-union calendars, per-symbol netting on the current chain contract, USD cash aggregation asserted every session against an independent event-log recomputation, per-bar portfolio MTM/equity/drawdown on the HELD contract's closes under a frozen-marks protocol (the current close is never visible at its own open), per-session aggregated margin utilization series, portfolio cutoff + future-mutation hooks, and a gate protocol as the ONLY enforcement path (structural caps at the decision close over the effective book incl. same-close pendings; margin admission at the fill open) — every block lands as a VETO/blocked-signal journal record with a machine code, never a silent clip/rescale. composition.py: PortfolioRiskCaps.enforce_veto (wired veto mode; legacy clip-mode enforce demoted to analysis-only), PortfolioRiskGate (reference gate with full audit trail), sleeve series from wired runs (daily sleeve PnL = delta(cash+MTM), exposure-gated), co-loss/overlap descriptives from journals, blocked-signal accounting reconciling gate audit vs journals, combined breakeven under one shared frozen tolerance (ambiguous/censored excluded, never netted), AlwaysOn baseline, portfolio_leave_one_leg full-path harness, baselines flat/always-on/single-leg wired over portfolio runs. accounting.py: drawdown_series/max_drawdown (arithmetic levels only). Adversarial coverage (62 new tests, tests/test_portfolio_*.py): concurrent CL+6J+ES (three quote conventions incl. negative-capable CL and USD-per-JPY 6J) with exact USD cash math reproduced from the declared cost model; roll in one symbol while another holds; margin-cap breach -> blocked+journaled with exact shortfall math, other sleeves byte-identical to the ungated run; per-sleeve/concurrency/gross/notional vetoes counting same-close pendings; portfolio-wide future-mutation invariance + future-view trap + gate-audit calendar bound; breakeven on the combined journal incl. ambiguous-bounds and censored exclusions; leave-one-leg non-additivity PROVEN with a binding margin cap (removing the small 6J leg unblocks ES: marginal effect sign flips vs the leg's own PnL; single-leg sums are not the portfolio decomposition). README: new 'Portfolio / multi-asset disclosures' section (12 wired+tested rows, 8 NOT_IMPLEMENTED rows with one-line reasons, daily/intraday scope table: DAILY fixtures end-to-end TESTED; intraday NOT_IMPLEMENTED incl. intrabar path beyond AMBIGUOUS_ORDER bounds); exec-disclosure rows for MTM/DD/margin/caps and risk-cap freeze updated from NOT_IMPLEMENTED(scaffold) to IMPLEMENTED+TESTED(portfolio layer); suite counts updated.
findings: EXEC-FIX defect found, reproduced with failing tests FIRST, then fixed: the R2 end-of-run independent journal<->cash reconciliation skipped right-censored records wholesale, but a censored record with EXECUTED roll legs has realize events in the ledger -> identity exploded (cash 1,003,757.45 != journal identity 999,997.45 in the repro). Any hold-through-roll-to-end-of-data run tripped it, incl. the ALWAYS-ON baseline the launch draft specifies. BEFORE: AssertionError 'independent journal<->cash reconciliation failed: journal gross 0.0 != ledger realize events 3760.0'. AFTER: censored records contribute their EXECUTED segment gross (record still claims NO point trade PnL; disclosure note + censored_realized_segments_usd stat added). Repro: tests/test_portfolio_composition.py::TestCensoredRollLegReconciliation (single-symbol AND portfolio paths). The defect was in EXEC-FIX's delivered uncommitted engine.py (logic verbatim from their run(); verified by git diff showing only self.-prefix changes around jr_gross).

Within-session lookahead caught in my own first wiring (self-caught, before any test): marks were published per-symbol mid-session, so symbol S2's fill-time margin check at session t's open could see S1's session-t CLOSE. Fixed with the frozen-marks protocol (gate reads marks of the last COMPLETED session; a just-filled position marks at its own fill price, MTM 0).

Notional caps at the decision close need the symbol's own same-session close: engine publishes it before the symbol's step (close is settled information at its own decision close); other symbols' prices stay at their latest stepped close (PIT-safe, disclosed).

Concurrency/gross caps MUST count same-close pending entries (effective book) or N same-close signals each see an empty book and over-admit; implemented in PortfolioEngine.effective_book() and used by the gate.
Single-symbol engine stays cap-free by design: caps are portfolio-level law; PortfolioEngine is the enforcement surface (README discloses this).

With the published broker margin tables, portfolio margin interactions make leg PnL provably non-additive: in the tight-cash scenario 6J and CL each trade ONLY inside the portfolio (their solo cash is below their own margin) and removing tiny-cash 6J (margin 3,080 vs cash 500) unblocks ES — the additive shortcut would be directionally wrong, which the leave-one-leg harness now demonstrates mechanically.
All 62 new tests are offline on deterministic synthetic fixtures in the exact raw IBKR schema; zero real data, zero registration/GO/S1/sweeps.

known_limitations: Intraday/intrabar portfolio anything: NOT_IMPLEMENTED (session-atomic replay; intrabar path beyond AMBIGUOUS_ORDER bounds unknowable from daily bars; no M1/H1 execution layer).
Intra-symbol multiple concurrent positions / offsetting: NOT_IMPLEMENTED (one net position per sleeve per chain).
Forced liquidation / de-risking on cap breach mid-run: NOT_IMPLEMENTED (caps block NEW exposure only; no declared liquidation policy exists).
Maintenance-margin call sequencing: NOT_IMPLEMENTED (admission checks initial margin on new fills).
Cross-margining / SPAN offsets: NOT_IMPLEMENTED (margins summed from PUBLISHED broker tables; CME SPAN NOT_RUN).
Notional caps use latest session close x multiplier (abs; negative-CL safe), not live BBO.
Same-close sequencing across symbols is deterministic sorted order (later symbols' fill admission sees earlier same-open fills; a simultaneous auction is NOT implemented, disclosed as convention).
Gate margin admission uses pre-fill equity at last-completed-session marks, fill commissions excluded (conservative direction: blocks earlier, not later).
Sleeve daily PnL for AMBIGUOUS_ORDER exits uses the ledger-booked worst-case bound (disclosed in-series); descriptives remain description-only.
Real-data portfolio runs: NOT_RUN (registered cycle required).
